Based on the control/equivalent block diagram in the image, provide DAE annotations for dynamic modeling, including control units, inputs, states, outputs, differential equations, and algebraic equations.
annotations.es:
<image>
A partir del diagrama de bloques de control o equivalente de la imagen, proporciona anotaciones DAE para el modelado dinámico, incluidas las unidades de control, las entradas, los estados, las salidas, las ecuaciones diferenciales y las ecuaciones algebraicas.
annotations.ar:
<image>
استنادًا إلى مخطط كتل التحكم أو المخطط المكافئ في الصورة، قدّم توصيفًا بنظام المعادلات التفاضلية الجبرية (DAE) للنمذجة الديناميكية، يتضمن وحدات التحكم والمدخلات ومتغيرات الحالة والمخرجات والمعادلات التفاضلية والمعادلات الجبرية.
annotations.fr:
<image>
À partir du schéma fonctionnel de commande ou du schéma équivalent présenté dans l’image, fournissez des annotations DAE pour la modélisation dynamique, comprenant les unités de commande, les entrées, les états, les sorties, les équations différentielles et les équations algébriques.
annotations.ru:
<image>
На основе структурной схемы управления или эквивалентной схемы на изображении представьте аннотацию в форме дифференциально-алгебраических уравнений (DAE) для динамического моделирования, включая блоки управления, входы, состояния, выходы, дифференциальные и алгебраические уравнения.

conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Power and frequency references","PLL","Voltage PIs and current limits","Current PIs","Measurement and command coordinate transforms"],"inputs":["P_wtref","P_wt","Q_wt","Q_wtref","v_fa","v_fb","v_fc","i_sa","i_sb","i_sc","i_wa","i_wb","i_wc"],"states":["xP","xPLL","theta","xVd","xVq","xId","xIq"],"outputs":["v_ca_cmd","v_cb_cmd","v_cc_cmd"],"differential_equations":["xP_dot=k_pi*(P_wtref-P_wt)","xPLL_dot=k_li*v_fq","theta_dot=omega_wt","xVd_dot=k_vi*eVd","xVq_dot=k_vi*eVq","xId_dot=k_ii*eId","xIq_dot=k_ii*eIq"],"algebraic_equations":["v_fd=D(v_fabc); v_fq=Q(v_fabc)","i_sd=D(i_sabc); i_sq=Q(i_sabc)","i_wd=D(i_wabc); i_wq=Q(i_wabc)","eP=P_wtref-P_wt","omega_wt=omega_n0+k_lp*v_fq+xPLL; omega=omega_wt","omega_wtref=omega_n0+k_q*(Q_wt-Q_wtref)","v_fdref=clip(v_fd0+k_pp*eP+xP,V_d_min,V_d_max)","v_fqref=k_f*(omega_wtref-omega_wt)","eVd=v_fdref-v_fd; eVq=v_fqref-v_fq","uId=k_vp*eVd+xVd+i_sd-omega*C*v_fq","uIq=k_vp*eVq+xVq+i_sq+omega*C*v_fd","i_wdref=clip(uId,I_d_min,I_d_max)","i_wqref=clip(uIq,I_q_min,I_q_max)","eId=i_wdref-i_wd; eIq=i_wqref-i_wq","v_cd=k_ip*eId+xId+v_fd-omega*L*i_wq","v_cq=k_ip*eIq+xIq+v_fq+omega*L*i_wd","v_ca_cmd=v_cd*sin(theta)+v_cq*cos(theta)","v_cb_cmd=v_cd*sin(theta-2*pi/3)+v_cq*cos(theta-2*pi/3)","v_cc_cmd=v_cd*sin(theta-4*pi/3)+v_cq*cos(theta-4*pi/3)"],"notes":"xP is active-power integral voltage; xPLL PLL integral frequency; theta unwrapped angle; xVd,xVq voltage-PI current contributions; xId,xIq current-PI voltage contributions. For phase h=0,1,2, a_h=theta-2*pi*h/3, D(z)=(2/3)*sum(z_h*sin(a_h)) and Q(z)=(2/3)*sum(z_h*cos(a_h)); the inverse omits zero sequence. omega=omega_wt=theta_dot; C=C_f,L=L_w. v_fd0 is nominal bias and omega_n0 nominal rad/s. Powers use W/var, voltages V and currents A positive toward the network. PI gains use output/error and output/(error*s); k_q maps var to rad/s and k_f rad/s to V. clip(z,l,u)=min(u,max(l,z)), l<=u, independently limits voltage and each current reference without anti-windup. All parameters, inputs and seven initial values are finite."}

conversations.value:
<image>
请基于图中的控制/等效框图，输出用于动态建模的DAE标注，包含控制单元、输入、状态、输出、微分方程与代数方程。

{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"hard","control_units":["Input conditioning","Washout","Three lead-lag compensators","Output limiter","Voltage-dependent cutoff"],"inputs":["u_s","e_ts","V_T0","V_T"],"states":["x_s","x_v","x_w","x_1","x_2","x_3"],"outputs":["V_ST"],"differential_equations":["dx_s/dt = (K_QS*u_s-x_s)/T_QS","dx_v/dt = (K_QV*dV-x_v)/T_QV","dx_w/dt = (z-x_w)/T_Q","dx_1/dt = (w-x_1)/T_Q1","dx_2/dt = (y_1-x_2)/T_Q2","dx_3/dt = (y_2-x_3)/T_Q3"],"algebraic_equations":["dV = V_T0 - V_T","z = K_QS*e_ts + x_s - x_v","w = z - x_w","y_1 = x_1 + (T_Q1_prime/T_Q1)*(w-x_1)","y_2 = x_2 + (T_Q2_prime/T_Q2)*(y_1-x_2)","y_3 = x_3 + (T_Q3_prime/T_Q3)*(y_2-x_3)","V_S_prime = min(V_SMAX,max(V_SMIN,y_3))","V_ST = V_S_prime if (V_CUTOFF<=0 or abs(dV)<=V_CUTOFF) else 0"],"notes":"x_s,x_v are input-lag outputs, x_w washout low-pass memory and x_1,x_2,x_3 lead-lag memories. u_s is a supplied selected slip/frequency/power measurement; e_ts is separate direct input; dV=V_T0-V_T. All quantities and six initial memories are finite real; denominator time parameters T_QS,T_QV,T_Q,T_Q1,T_Q2,T_Q3 are nonzero. V_SMIN<=V_SMAX. Limiter/cutoff are static and memories continue evolving. V_CUTOFF<=0 disables cutoff; positive cutoff passes at equality and forces zero only above threshold, without post-gate reclipping. Both K_QS occurrences share the same gain."}
